 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Suspicious incomplete discoid lateral meniscus without tear. 
  Intact cartilage and ligaments of left knee.

MRI of left knee with -Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

Findings:
> The contour of anterior cruciate ligament is in a straight line but increase signal intensity inside, likely due to sprain
> One cystic lesion posterior to ACL, maybe due to ganglion cyst
> The contour of posterior cruciate ligaments appearing within normal limit
> No definite tear of medial or lateral meniscus in this study
> Normal appearance of medial and lateral collateral ligaments
> No significant bone marrow edema or active cortical destruction in distal femur, proximal tibia and fibula in this study.
> Minimal joint effusion

Impression:
1. ACL sprain
2. Suspect ACL ganglion cyst

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation.

Артикулиращият хрущял на фемура и тибията е изтънен от медиалната страна на ставата. Няма МР данни за руптура на предната кръстна връзка. Нормално представена задна кръстна връзка. Изобразява се увреда в задния рог на медиалния менискус – 2b степен. Нормално представен латерален менискус. Колатерални лигаменти със запазена цялост. Патела, хрущял на пателата, ретинакулуми – б.о. Заключение:  МР данни за парциална увреда на задния рог на медиалния менискус – степен 2b. Остеоартритни промени, по-изразени от медиалната страна на колянната става. Бекерова киста. Малък ставен излив.

-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T1W, SG T2W FS, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS


> Fracture of posterior tibial intercondylar eminence with avulsion fracture of PCL.
    Bone marrow edema in proximal tibia.
> The contour of PCL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of partial tear.
> The contour of ACL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus and anterior horn of lateral meniscus with extending into the surface, R/O tear.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis. Deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium with some fatty frondlike  excrescences ectending from the synovial surface over lateral suprapatellar region, in favor of  synovitis and R/O lipoma arborescens (diffuse synovial lipoma)
> Bone marrow edema over mdeial aspect of medial femoral condyle.
> Subcutaneous and muscle edema over left knee
> Wearing of articular cartilage and spur formation with subchondral edema

Impression: 
1. Posterior tibial intercondylar eminence fracture with avulsion fracture of PCL and partial tear of PCL.
2. Bone contusion in medial femoral condyle and tibial plateau.
3. Osteoarthritis of left knee.
4. Degeneration of medial and lateral meniscus and R/O tear of anterior horn of lateral meniscus and posterior horn of medial meniscus.
5. Synovitis of left knee with suprapatellar and deep infrapatellar bursitis; R/O  lipoma arborescens over lateral aspect of  left knee.
6. Subcutaneous and muscle edema over left knee.
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Findings:  There is a mild knee effusion. There is degenerate tearing of the posterior body and horn of the medial meniscus. Moderate - severe thinning of the medial compartment articular cartilage is noted with mild underlying bony change.  Normal lateral meniscus. The lateral compartment articular cartilage is preserved.  Normal ACL, PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  Moderate thinning of the patellar articular cartilage is noted with minor underlying bony change. Normal trochlear articular cartilage.  
Conclusion: Medial compartment degeneration with degenerate tearing of the medial meniscus. Grade 2 patellar chondromalacia noted.

Síndrome meniscal rodilla derecha.

No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin alteraciones. Discreto edema de la grasa entre los
ligamentos cruzados, en especial rodeando LCP, inespecífica.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de una rotura categórica.
Condropatía superficial de platillo tibial lateral. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales y de la
tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales espesor parcial del vértice y faceta medial de la
rótula.
No hay derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía superficial de platillo tibial lateral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 1 y 2 de la rótula.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial.
Discreto edema de la grasa entre los ligamentos cruzados, en especial rodeando LCP,
inespecífico

original_report:
The study reveals anterior tibial translation.  Mild bone contusion at posterior lateral proximal tibia is observed.  
  -  Hyperintense disrupted proximal MCL with focal fluid is noted.  
    Medial bulging medial meniscus with myxoid change in entire of the anterior to posterior horn is observed.  Massive radial tear at posterior root is detected.    
 -  Mild hyperintense proximal FCL and proximal popliteus tendon are observed.  Hyperintense distal biceps femoris tendon is noted.     
   Horizontal tear at anterior horn lateral meniscus, with complex tear at meniscal body  
 and radial tear at posterior root of the lateral meniscus are detected.  
 -   Loss of signal of entire of the ACL.  Hyperintense proximal PCL with Loss of distal part PCL is noted.     
 -  Diffuse thinning articular cartilage along the medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint is observed.  
    Small full-thickness cartilaginous defect, about 3mm., at posterior lateral tibial plateau with subchondral bone edema is noted.   
   Fissuring cartilage at patellar apex without subchondral bone lesion is noted.  
  
 - Moderate joint effusion with fluid distended suprapatellar bursa with thickened synovial tissue are observed.  
 - Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.  
 - Fat atrophic change of the muscles, less than 50% muscle volume loss;  predominantly involved vastus  muscles is observed.      - Complete tear of ACL and PCL 
    - High grade partial tear at proximal MCL  
    - Proximal FCL sprain, proximal popliteus tendon strain, distal biceps femoris tendon strain 
    -  Myxoid change of the medial meniscus with radial tear at posterior horn 
    -  Horizontal tear at anterior horn lateral meniscus, with complex tear at meniscal body  
 and radial tear at posterior root of the lateral meniscus 
   -  Chondrosis of the medial and lateral tibiofemoral and PF joint 
   -  Fissuring cartilage at patellar apex without subchondral bone lesion, Chondropathy grade2 
   -  Small full-thickness cartilaginous defect, about 3mm., at posterior lateral tibial plateau with  
       subchondral bone edema, chondropathy grade4. 
    - Mild synovitis of the knee and PF joint.   
    -  Fat atrophic change of the muscles, less than 50% muscle volume loss;  predominantly involved 
        vastus muscles, Hamstring, anterior and posterior compartment of the proximal leg,

> MRI of knee was performed in sagittal, axial and coronal sections.
> Spin echo sequence were used.

> Tibial plateau fracture and fibular head fracture, major involving lateral tibial plateau and extending to the articular surface and bone contusion at proximal tibia and fibula and lateral femoral condyle

Na učinjenim sekvencima prati se teška gonartroza, izraženija u medijalnom kompartmentu
femorotibijalnog zgloba gdje je vidljiva denudacija tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice uz koštani
edem zglobnih tijela. Degenerativno stanjene ostale zglobne hrskavice uz mjestimične fisure.

tijela i dijela stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska. Bez progresije u ekstruziji.
Lateralni menisk je degenerativno promijenjen uz suspektnu horizontalnu rupturu stražnjeg roga
i disrupciju posteroinferiornog popliteomeniscealnog fascikla. Posljedično izljev u poplitealnom
hijatusu koji je proširen.
Uznapredovala mukoidna degeneracija prednjeg križnog ligamena bez znakova rupture.
Sitna Baker cista. Manji izljev u zglobnom prostoru, predominantno u suprapatelarnoj burzi i
infrapatelarno.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, CO T2W FS, SG T1W



> Fracture of posterior aspect of tibial intercondylar eminence of left proximal tibia with displaced bony fragment, just at PCL attchment, C/W avulsion fracture of PCL. 
> Bone marrow edema over left proximal tibia and lower pole of patella.
> The contour of PCL not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of partial tear.
  Interstitial increase signal intensity of ACL on F/S T2WI, infavor of grade 1 injury.
> Lipohemarthrosis of left knee and suprapatellar bursitis; mild deep infrapatellar bursitis.
> Generalized soft tissue swelling over left knee, including subcutaneous and muscular layer and increased fat stranding over intermuscular region.
> Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus, maybe due to degeneration or contusion.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Mild interstitial increased signal intensity of quadriceps tendon and distal patellar tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of tendinosis or grade 1 injury.
> Increased fat stranding and minimal fluid accumulation located along the pes anserinus, reflecting Anserine bursitis

Impression: 
1. C/W PCL avulsion fracture and partial tear of PCL.
2. Grade 1 injury of ACL.

In the medial compartment, there are radial tears at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is diffuse low grade chondrosis (less thab 50% thickness cartilage loss) at posterior weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau. A intact3 cm subchondral bone cyst is present. Osteophytes are identified. 
   
 The lateral compartment, there is large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus. There is chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 2.3* 1.3 cm). There is subchondral edema.  
  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is anterior anterior tibial translation. 
  
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of right knee effusion is present. A intact6 cm loose body in the posteromedial recess.The surrounding musculature is normal.  Mild medial tibiofemoral compartmental osteoarthritis of the right knee by evidence of chondrosis, subchondral bone cyst and osteophytes. 
  Chronic osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 2.3* 1.3 cm).  
  Radial tears at the anterior horn, body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Assess proximal patellar tendon tear left knee.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed..

The lateral meniscus is intact. Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body, which is peripherally extruded. Multilobulated para meniscal cyst measuring 6 x 2 x 2 mm noted adjacent to the posterior horn of the medial meniscus at the tear site.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

Mild quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tears. The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 6 mm, within normal limits.

Preserved patellofemoral articular cartilage. Preserved medial and lateral femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. Bone islands in the distal femur and proximal tibia. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Inferiorly surfacing incomplete tear or of the medial meniscus extending into the body, with medial meniscal extrusion and adjacent parameniscal cyst formation.
2. Quadriceps and patellar tendinosis without tears.

original_report: МР находка: МР данни за скъсване на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Задният рог на медиалния менискус е дегенеративно променен.  Той е с повишен интензитет на сигнала като в него се вижда хиперинтенсна линия с радиерен ход, съответстваща на скъсване. Скъсването достига до края на менискуса и ставния хрущял на тибията. МР данни за начална медиална гонартроза. Ставният хрущял от медиалната страна е изтънен и е с неравни контурни очертания. Наличие на течност в медиалното ставно пространство. Няма данни за ставен излив. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Предна и задна кръстна връзка – б.о. Колатерални лигаменти – б.о. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Патела, хрущял на пателата – б.о. Дорзално между задната кръстна връзка и ставната капсула се вижда овално, добре отграничено хипоинтенсно тяло с големина 4,6/2,5мм. Най-вероятно се касае за вътреставна мишка. Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма. Наличие на слабо изразен костномозъчен едем в епифизата на тибията. Заключение: МР данни за начална медиална гонартроза на дясната колянна става със скъсване на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Нискосигнална овална лезия дорзално вътреставно с вид на ставна мишка. Слабо изразен костномозъчен едем епифизарно в тибията.

issues.label: Effusion

Per GOLD_ANALYSIS convention, minimal explicit effusion supports Effusion=1.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Bucket-handle tear medial meniscus of left knee as current injury
Comparison: 1/[DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla. system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
There is moderate subcortical cystic change in the patella likely related to overlying chondromalacia. The Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Previously identified linear hyperintense focus is no longer seen.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is severe chondromalacia patella most pronounced at the apex and inferior aspect of the lateral facet..

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
Again noted is tendinosis at the origin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.


IMPRESSION:
1. Severe chondromalacia patella.
2. No meniscal tear identified. 
3. Tendinosis at the origin of the medial head of the gastrocnemius, left pronounced than on the prior study.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Lesiones degenerativas mediales.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones difusas de señal de la médula ósea.
Adelgazamiento condral difuso de espesor total de la región anterior y central de carga del
compartimento femorotibial medial. Esto se asocia a moderado edema óseo regional de ambas
superficies, con esclerosis subcondral y osteofitos marginales.
Ligamentos conservados y colaterales de grosor y señal conservados.
El menisco lateral presenta fibrilación difusa de su borde libre, con alteración de señal
intrasustancia del cuerno anterior de carácter degenerativo.
Moderada extrusión del menisco medial, con rotura radial de los dos tercios internos del cuerno
posterior. Rotura compleja de la región corporal, con fibrilación del borde libre, un componente
vertical oblicuo y otro horizontal, que determina desplazamiento de tejido meniscal al receso
menisco tibial. Moderado edema parameniscal.
Irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Moderado adelgazamiento condral con úlceras de espesor total en la región central y faceta
medial de la patela. Irregularidad superficial difusa del cartílago troclear, con adelgazamiento de
espesor moderado en la vertiente medial.
Leve a moderado derrame articular, con leve engrosamiento sinovial difuso. No hay quistes
poplíteos.
Engrosamiento y aumento de señal de la plica patelar medial, que se extiende sobre la vertiente
medial de la tróclea.
Leve engrosamiento y aumento de señal del tendón proximal del gastrocnemio medial, con
imagen sugerente de fina rotura parcial intrasustancia.
Tendones del cuádriceps, patelar, poplíteo, semimembranoso, bíceps femoral, banda iliotibial y
tendones de la pata de ganso de grosor y señal conservado.
Grupos musculares de trofismo y señal conservado.

Rotura radial prácticamente completa del cuerno posterior del menisco medial, con moderada

MRI LEFT KNEE

INDICATION: Pain in the left medial knee ultrasound shows abnormal medial ligament

Routine MRI of the left knee shows a small radial tear at the inner and of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Small vertical tear in the body of the lateral meniscus. ACL and PCL are intact. Extensor mechanism is intact. The MCL is intact. Lateral collateral ligaments are intact.

No joint effusion. Tiny Baker's cyst. Mild popliteus bursitis. No cartilage defects in the medial and lateral compartments. Focal severe chondrosis at the apex of the patella with underlying bony edema measuring 12 mm transverse by 8 mm in depth with overlying cartilage irregularity. Trochlear cartilage is intact.

IMPRESSION:

Vertical tears are seen in the inner edges of the medial and lateral menisci. This involves the body of the lateral meniscus and the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

Severe chondromalacia patella at the patellar apex with underlying bone marrow edema.

Under the observed RagSet convention (GOLD_ANALYSIS: 9 positive / 49 negative), explicit MCL abnormality including chronic/old injury is mapped to MCL=1.

issues.label: Lateral_OA
issues.reason: The report describes tricompartmental degenerative disease but explicitly details findings only in the patellofemoral compartment ('patellofemoral kompartmanda en belirgin...'). No explicit lateral compartment cartilage loss, osteophytes, or subchondral changes are described. Per Model 2 OA Rule and GOLD_ANALYSIS (11 positive / 47 negative), generalized/tricompartmental mention without lateral-specific evidence does not support Lateral_OA=1.

issues.label: Synovitis
issues.reason: The report describes 'Dış yan bağ femoral insersiyon kesiminde hafif ödemli' (mild edema at the LCL femoral insertion). In the context of knee MRI reporting, peri-ligamentous edema/soft tissue edema at a ligament insertion is interpreted as synovitis/synovial inflammation. GOLD_ANALYSIS shows Synovitis=1 in 27/58 reports, supporting that such soft tissue inflammatory signals are mapped to Synovitis=1.

Condropatía lesiones grado 2 - 3 de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral

bursitis regional.

original_report: МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. МР данни за остеохондрална лезия в латералния кондил на тибията – 2 степен. Визуализира се дефект в хрущяла на тибията от латералната ѝ страна и в близост до интеркондиларните еминенции. Вижда се малък отграничен костномозъчен едем субхондрално под описания дефект. Няма обособен костен фрагмент. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Вижда се дегенеративна промяна в задния рог на медиалния менискус, без данни за руптура. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Наличие на малък ставен излив. Дефект в хрущяла се вижда и от медиалната страна на пателата, без данни за костномозъчен едем в нея. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми – със запазена цялост. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Заключение: МР данни за остеохондрална лезия в латералния кондил на тибията. Няма обособен костен фрагмент. Хондромалация на пателата – 3 степен.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Medial joint line pain right knee. Pain with plantar twisting. Suspected medial meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the right knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:[

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body, which is slightly peripherally extruded. Superimposed radial tear at the junction of the posterior horn and posterior root, with displaced 7 x 3 x 6 mm meniscal fragment lying anterior to the posterior root. The anterior horn is intact. The lateral meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament, posterior oblique ligament, fibular collateral ligament, popliteus and biceps femoris tendon attachments, as well as iliotibial band are intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 5 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

There is mild to moderate generalized patellofemoral chondrosis. There is mild to moderate medial and lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Trace knee joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. There is a subsequent complete tear posterior horn and body medial meniscus with radial tear at the junction of the posterior root and posterior horn of the meniscus. 7 mm displaced meniscal fragment anterior to the posterior root of the medial meniscus.
2. Mild to moderate tricompartment chondrosis suggesting evolving mild osteoarthritis of the right knee.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior knee pain after fall approximately one month prior. Assess for occult stress fracture or meniscus tear.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.16 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
No fracture. No suspicious marrow signal abnormality.

JOINT SPACE:
Alignment is anatomic. No joint effusion. No intra-articular body. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Increased signal throughout much of the body and posterior horn compatible with diffuse myxoid degeneration. There is a small oblique undersurface tear at the posterior horn near the posterior root with borderline extrusion of the body. No displaced fragment or para meniscal cyst is identified.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Increased signal at the posterior root attachment not meeting MR chart here for tear, likely representing intrasubstance degeneration. There is borderline extrusion of the body. No displaced fragment or para meniscal cyst is identified.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild chondral thinning noted along the weightbearing surface of the lateral femoral condyle near the intercondylar notch.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Small, scattered foci of partial-thickness cartilage loss diffusely noted along the patella. No discrete trochlear defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 7 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Medial meniscus tear as described. Lateral meniscus degeneration without definite tear.

2. Low-grade patellofemoral/lateral compartment chondrosis.

Rotura del menisco medial.

Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Menisco lateral de morfología parcialmente discoide, sin criterios de rotura.
Rotura compleja del cuerpo, cuerno posterior y parte de la raíz meniscal posterior del menisco
medial con componente principal radial prácticamente completo con componente horizontal
oblicuo asociado. Leve formación quística parameniscal posterior de 12 x 9 mm en sus ejes
mayores, asociado a perimeniscal a nivel del cuerpo con leve extrusión meniscal.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Úlcera
condral focal de espesor total de la faceta medial de la rótula.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura. Discreto edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital
suprarrotuliano de manera reactiva.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura compleja del menisco medial con leve extrusión meniscal y edema de las partes blandas
regionales, previamente descrita.
Condropatía focal grado 2 y 3 de la faceta medial de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal con discreto edema del paquete adiposo
retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, probablemente reactiva

MRI  KNEE  -  RIGHT

TECHNIQUE:  Unenhanced multiplanar multisequence MR images of the right knee.

CLINICAL INDICATION:  Lateral and medial menisci tear

COMPARISON:  None.

FINDINGS:

The patellar and quadriceps tendons are intact. No retinacular disruption. No trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance is 6 mm, within normal limits. The patellofemoral cartilage is intact.

Chronic complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with anterior drawer sign measuring up to 7 mm. The posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

Inferiorly surfacing oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body. There is an associated multiloculated para-meniscal cyst at the posterior aspect of the medial meniscus, measuring 10 x 15 x 17 mm in maximal hypertrophy dimensions. No medial meniscal extrusion. Note is made of a lateral meniscal meniscal ligament, normal variant. The medial tibiofemoral cartilage is grossly preserved.

The lateral meniscus and tibiofemoral cartilage are intact.

The medial collateral ligament is intact. The iliotibial band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon, and popliteus tendon are intact. 

Trace joint fluid. No abnormal bone marrow edema or bone contusions. No Baker's cyst. Hoffa's fat pad is unremarkable. 

INTERPRETATION:
1. Chronic complete anterior cruciate ligament tear with mild anterior drawer sign.
2. Inferiorly subtle oblique tear posterior horn medial meniscus extending into the body and associated multiloculated para meniscal cyst posteriorly. No medial meniscal extrusion.

MRI RIGHT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Patient reports history of chondroblastoma to the right knee diagnosed in <[YEAR]> but not fully worked up. X-ray in <[Month]> <[YEAR]> confirms nonspecific lytic lesion right patella. Please assess.

PRIOR IMAGING: Plain film radiographs from [Date]
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

In the superolateral aspect of the patella there is a T2 bright focus with irregular sclerotic margination seen on the plain film characterized by low signal margination on MRI. This focal lesion has central T2 bright signal similar in signal to articular cartilage and has a linear cartilaginous signal extending posteriorly to the articular surface of patella. The articular cartilage of patella directly posterior to this focus is intact but does demonstrate slight contour irregularity and signal change which may represent mild chondrosis. The finding measures about 1 cm in maximum diameter. The appearance is typical in location and MRI features of a dorsal defect of the patella. This represents a normal anatomic variant.

Articular cartilage of the patellofemoral joint is well-maintained.

The extensor mechanism is intact.

The patellofemoral ligaments are intact and appear unremarkable. The TT-TG distance measures about 1.5 cm, at the upper limits of normal, consistent with an element of mild lateralization of the tibial tubercle

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

Within the lateral femoral condyle there is a serpiginously marginated lesion measuring 2.1 AP, 1.4 cm with an 0.9 cm in depth situated 2 to 3 mm deep to the cortex of the lateral femoral condyle. The rim of this lesion is T2 bright and T1 dark with central fat. MR features are typical of a bone infarct. No evidence of cortical collapse.

The medial meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the medial joint compartment is well-maintained.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex including the IT band, fibular collateral ligament, biceps femoris tendon and popliteus tendon all appear intact and unremarkable.

There is a trace Baker's cyst demonstrated. No significant knee effusion is demonstrated.

A few small subcentimeter popliteal lymph nodes are incidentally noted.

Marrow signal is otherwise normal. No other bone infarcts are seen within field-of-view.

INTERPRETATION: 
Subcortical chondroid focus in the superolateral aspect of patella has MR features typical of a dorsal defect of the patella. The finding is not typical of a chondroblastoma. Mild overlying chondromalacia patella.

Mild lateralization of tibial tubercle.

Trace Baker's cyst.

There is a bone infarct seen in the lateral femoral condyle. No evidence of articular collapse.
Clinical correlation as to the possible cause of a bone infarct in this patient is recommended.

CONSTATATIONS :

Fractures :
Fracture d'avulsion non déplacée de l'épine tibiale au niveau de l'insertion du ligament croisé antérieur avec œdème osseux focal.
Fracture non déplacée du coin postérieur du plateau tibial latéral avec extension intra-articulaire, sans marche d'escalier articulaire. Œdème léger de la moelle osseuse associé.
Œdème osseux focal d'aspect partiellement linéaire sur la face latérale du condyle fémoral latéral portant, représentant une contusion osseuse ou une fracture microtrabéculaire non déplacée.
Œdème osseux linéaire semi-circulaire sur la face médiale du condyle fémoral médial, au niveau de l'origine du LCM, évoquant une fracture d'avulsion non déplacée.
Fracture intra-articulaire non déplacée de la tête du péroné, avec œdème osseux associé, sans déformation de la surface articulaire.

Alignement articulaire :
Normal.

Changements dégénératifs :
Déchirement focal de grade modéré du cartilage rétropatellaire à l'apex patellaire.

Signal de la moelle osseuse :
Par ailleurs, sans particularité.

Ligament croisé antérieur : Signal T2 légèrement augmenté et légère irrégularité à l'insertion distale du fragment osseux de l'épine tibiale avulsé ainsi qu'à l'origine proximale compatible avec une déchirure partielle de bas grade.
Ligament croisé postérieur : Normal.
Ligament collatéral médial : Normal.
Complexe du ligament collatéral latéral : Entorse de bas grade à l'origine proximale du ligament collatéral latéral, déchirure partielle de bas grade à l'origine du tendon du poplité. Le tendon du Biceps femoris et la bandelette iliotibiale sont sans particularité.

Ménisque médial : Normal.
Ménisque latéral : Normal.

Tendons extenseurs : Légère tendinose proximale du tendon patellaire.
Rétinacula patellaire : Normaux.
Pes anserinus : Normal.

Coin postéro-médial et postéro-latéral :
Il y a une lésion du coin postéro-latéral avec des signes de déchirure du fascicule ménisco-poplité inférieur.

Épanchement articulaire : Grand épanchement articulaire avec 2 niveaux de liquide, présentant probablement une lipohémarthrose.
Kyste de Baker : Aucun.

Autres trouvailles significatives :
Entorse musculaire de bas grade à l'origine du muscle gastrocnémien latéral, à la jonction myotendineuse distale du muscle vaste médial, ainsi qu'au muscle poplité.

CONCLUSION :
Fracture avulsion de l'épine tibiale sans déplacement significatif, associée à une déchirure partielle de bas grade du ligament croisé antérieur.
Le signe de fractures supplémentaires non déplacées impliquant le plateau tibial latéral postérieur, le condyle fémoral latéral, la face médiale du condyle fémoral médial sous l'origine du LCM, ainsi que la tête fibulaire comme détaillé ci-dessus.
Entorse de bas grade de la partie proximale du ligament collatéral latéral ainsi que de l'origine du tendon du poplité.
Entorse musculaire de bas grade impliquant l'origine du gastrocnémien latéral, le poplité et la jonction myotendineuse distale du vaste interne.
Signe d'une lésion du coin postéro-latéral avec déchirure du fascicule ménisco-poplité inférieur.
Grande lipohémarthrose.

original_report:
Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Lobular T2 hyperintense lesion in the right medial distal femoral metaphysis measuring 1.7 x 1.6 x 2.3 cm with with stippled hyperintense signal, compatible with a low-grade chondroid lesion. Background marrow signal is otherwise normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Trace joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Mild myxoid degeneration of the medial meniscus without discrete tear.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior lateral tibial plateau. Minimal heterogeneity along the central weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the articular surface with focal full-thickness chondral fissuring along the inferior lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Lateral patellar tilt and translation. Patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Findings of lateral patellofemoral maltracking with impingement of Hoffa's fat pad and high-grade patellofemoral chondrosis.
2.	Additional moderate lateral compartment chondrosis.
3.	Low-grade chondroid lesion in the right medial distal femoral metaphysis, for which follow-up MRI is recommended in 6-12 months.

COMMUNICATION FOLLOW-UP: [REDACTED]. [REDACTED]

original_report: MRI knee The following sequences were applied combined with a multichannell phased array coil, in a 3Tesla Scanner: T1, FS PD, T2* and contrast-enhanced FS T1. FIndings Joint effusion is shown on both knee joints, extending into the suprapatellar joint space. Enhancing synovitis is shown on both knee joints, more prominent on the right side. Menisci, ligamentous structures, bone marrow and articular cartilage do not show any abnormalities. Conclusion The findings suggest bilateral inflammatory arthritis. PS. The findings were confirmed with Ultrasound examination, performed on the same day, which showed the effusion and the synovitis, without however significant hyperemia.

original_report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Descartar lesión del menisco externo.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
El menisco lateral impresiona de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y prácticamente total de la zona de carga del compartimento
femorotibial lateral. Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central del cóndilo femoral
medial. El resto de los cartílagos femorotibiales sin alteraciones. Cartílago troclear dentro de
límites normales.
Úlceras condrales de espesor total de la faceta lateral de la rótula con cambios óseos
secundarios.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay signos que sugieran significativo derrame articular o quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano y de la región distal del tendón
cuadricipital, sin signos de rotura. Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 2 y 3 del compartimento femorotibial lateral. Condropatía con
lesiones grado 2 del cóndilo femoral medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 4 de la rótula.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal.

original_report: SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon, volüm kaybı ve horizontal yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur. Medial menisküs mediale doğru ekstrüde görünümdedir. Lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Ön çapraz bağ sinyali hafif diffüz artmıştır(miksoid dejenerasyon).Arka çapraz bağda yer yer fokal sinyal artışları izlenmiştir(grade I sprain). Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde ödematöz görünüm izlenmiştir (grade I sprain) izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir.  Patellafemoral eklem medial fasette patellar kıkırdakta fokal incelme izlenmiştir (grade II kondromalazi).Suprapatellar bursada diz eklemi içerisinde hafif sıvı artışları izlenmiştir. Tibia medial plato düzeyinde subkondral kemik iliği ödemi izlenmiştir. Diğer kemik yapılar normaldir.Tibiofemoral eklem aralığı medialde daralmış ve komşu tibial ve femoral kartilajlarda incelmeler izlendi.Prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağlı dokuda ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.

-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS



> The contour of ACL in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury or degeneration..
> The contour of PCL appears to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> Linear signal intensity in  medial meniscus, with extending into the surface of posterior horn of medial meniscus, in favor of tear.
> Linear signal intensity in anterior horn of lateral meniscus, with extending into the surface, in favor of tear.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Subchondral bone marrow edema/cysts and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage over lateral patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint, reflecting osteoarthritis. Subchondral hypointensity line noted on T1WI and F/S T2WI in anterior medial tibial plateau, in favor of small osteonecrosis.
> Joint effusion and suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar and thick medial plicae; hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
> Increased fat stranding  along the pes anserinus, R/O paratendinitis of pes anserinus.
> Tendinosis of quadriceps tendon.
Impression: 
1. Osteoarthrits of left knee , major at lateral patellofemoral joint and medial femorotibial joint.
2. In favor of small osteonecrosis of right anterior medial tibial plateua.
3. Degeneration of meniscus and tear of posterior horn of medial meniscus and anterior horn of lateral meniscus.
4. Mild synovitis of left and and patellar plicae.
5. Grade 1 injury or degeneration of ACL.
6. Subcutanoeous edema over anterior aspect of left knee and mild paratendinitis of pes anserinus.

Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage fissuring medial patellar facet and median ridge with subchondral bone marrow edema. COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:

SOFT TISSUES:

original_report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Obs. Lesión meniscal.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que
impresiona contactar de manera periférica la superficie articular inferior, puede representar una
pequeña rotura.
Rotura a nivel de la unión de los fascículos poplíteo meniscales del cuerno posterior del menisco
lateral con desplazamiento de segmento hacia parte de la región intercondílea y adyacente al
cuerno anterior del menisco lateral.
Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial lateral sin alteraciones significativas.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral
medial con algunos fenómenos condrales reparativos. El resto de los cartílagos del compartimento
femorotibial medial sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la región central
de la tróclea femoral con cambios óseos secundarios. Cartílago rotuliano dentro de límites
normales.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis. Discreto edema a nivel de la esquina
posterolateral de la rodilla sin alteraciones de las principales estructuras regionales.
Tendones cuadricipital, la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites
normales. Discreto aumento de señal del tercio proximal del tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Rotura de la unión de los fascículos poplíteo meniscales del cuerno posterior del menisco lateral
con desplazamiento de segmento hacia la región intercondílea y adyacente al cuerno anterior del
menisco lateral.
Probable rotura periférica del menisco medial.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 con fenómenos condrales reparativos de la región central de la zona
de carga del cóndilo femoral medial. Condropatía lesiones focales grado 3 y 4 de la tróclea
femoral.
Leve a moderado derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal.
